definitions.gloss: snatching away; stealing; intercepting; seizing what belongs to another
definitions.explanation: The act of taking something that rightfully belongs to someone else, especially by swooping in from the side. Implies unfairness and opportunism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手柄|てがら}→手柄：10562_tegara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Someone stole the credit for my work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He always steals other people's ideas and claims them as his own.

notes:
From ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side/lateral) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking). The image is of someone coming from the side to snatch something away — an unexpected, unfair taking. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a suru-verb. Always carries a negative nuance of unfairness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手柄|てがら}→手柄：10562_tegara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to steal credit
- ⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to steal someone's prey/prize
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to poach a customer
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横取|よこど}り⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to have something snatched by...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to seize; to rob — a more forceful, direct taking
- {掠|かす}め{取|と}る: to snatch; to swipe — emphasizes speed and stealth
- ⟦{盗|ぬす}む→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧: to steal — the general word for stealing
- ⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧: embezzlement — a legal/formal term for misappropriating entrusted assets
